headline: JOCOM HOLDINGS CORP. cited accounting standard ASU 2023-09 for the first time in this filing series
label: Accounting standard newly cited
quote: The Company adopted the ASU 2023-09, “Income Taxes (Topic 740): Improvements to Income tax Disclosures”, which modifies the rules on income tax disclosures to require disaggregated information about a reporting entity’s effective tax rate reconciliation as well as information on income taxes paid.
